desc: Implement BFS to compute representable differences up to BFS_LIMIT (>=5000) and derive Frobenius number F.
Parse input, build bad intervals, and construct safe zones.
Simulate traversal between safe zones using representable differences.
Test the solution against all provided sample inputs and additional edge cases (M=0, adjacent bad intervals, large N, gcd>1).
Validate correctness by comparing with brute-force BFS for small N (N <= 100) over random configurations.
Refine helper functions for clarity and fix any bugs uncovered during testing.
